title: registry-verdict/1
description: One registry tier file per plugin: registry/<tier>/<plugin_id>.json holding a list of conformance-verdict entries (DESIGN.md 11 'Registry': verdicts keyed by (plugin version, contract version, framework line, suite version, golden-fixture hash); two tiers, one format; curated = framework-CI re-verified, main-grid eligible, open = self-attested, labeled, appendix-only).
$comment: DESIGN.md 11. Verdicts and registry facts are data, never executable. The `as_of` field records what the verdict was verified against (the exact key it was recorded under): staleness downgrades display, never hides the verdict. The $id host is a placeholder (DESIGN.md 'Open questions').

schema.$comment: DESIGN.md 4 'Stamps and versioning': bare literal 1; no type names inside data files.

tier.$comment: DESIGN.md 11 'Two tiers'. A curated entry may only be recorded by framework-CI re-verification; an open entry is self-attested and appendix-only.

verdict.$comment: A framework/conformance.py verdict object (L1 or L2). The required fields are the verdict key components (DESIGN.md 11) plus the kit identity and the check lists; the rest is additive.

attestation.$comment: Who vouches for the entry (DESIGN.md 11: curated is CI re-verified; open is self-attested).

verified_by.$comment: What verified the claim (never mark a claim verified that a check did not verify).

asOf.$comment: What the entry was verified against: the exact verdict key (DESIGN.md 11). Any component change makes the verdict stale; staleness downgrades the display (as-of), never hides it.
